name: Fairmont Windsor Park
positioning: Country-house style luxury spa hotel on the edge of Windsor Great Park, with lakeside grounds
best_for: Travelers who want a green, parkland base near Heathrow and Central London
Families and groups who want treehouse or two-bedroom suites

facts.text: The hotel sits on the edge of Windsor Great Park.
The hotel is surrounded by 40 acres of open green space and a lake.
The hotel is within easy reach of Heathrow Airport and Central London.
The spa has an indoor lap pool and a courtyard vitality pool.
The hotel offers a classic English Afternoon Tea.
The Macallan Experience pairs rare and new expressions of The Macallan whisky with food crafted by the executive chef.
il Gardino is a restaurant at the hotel.
The hotel offers padel and scenic bike rides as outdoor activities.
The Eaves rooms feature a circular window.
Dogs and other pets can be accommodated in a selection of rooms, subject to availability.

highlights.text: The Luxury Two Bedroom Treehouse Suite has two ensuite bedrooms, a living room with a wood burner and kitchenette, and a private hot tub on the terrace.
The Luxury Two Bedroom King Suite has two individually designed en-suite bedrooms and views over the lake and adjoining parkland.
The Signature Royal Suite has private access to the VIP spa.
The grounds and gardens serve as a playground for children.

considerations.text: The spa facilities are not accessible before check-in or after check-out.
WhataHotel notes the hotel is located outside central London.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing in line with its luxury positioning.
